description:
Is this Base token BASED / MID / COOKED / RADIOACTIVE? Deterministic verdict before you buy: grade, action (ENTER_OK / CAUTION / SKIP), confidence, red flags (honeypot, sell tax, mintable supply, owner privileges, holder concentration, thin liquidity) and expected loss for your amount. Call it before swapping into any Base token. Fail-closed: an unknown token returns UNKNOWN, never "safe". Risk screen, not investment advice. REST: GET|POST /api/v1/token/verdict ($0.02).

Args:
    token: ERC-20 contract address on Base (0x...)
    amount_usd: planned position size in USD (scales expected_loss_usd)
name: check_base_token_safety
title: Base token safety
